window.coordinates: normalized body (container-stripped, CRLF-normalized); spans in RAW file coordinates

notes: Genesis 1:1-8, Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed Hebrew with cantillation — field strings carry the exact accents of their own occurrence). The creation window: INS·Ground (the whole world-field brought into being), SEG·Ground twice (the primal divisions), EVA·Figure (saw-that-good), the naming acts, and the vayehi refrain. Verse labels (Gen.1.N) are reference furniture, not predications — folded by note. Ground addresses mirror the source's own chapter.verse.predication containment.

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִ֑ים
rows.because: בָּרָא (created) brings THE WHOLE FIELD OF BEING into existence — heavens-and-earth is the totality, not one thing: Generate·Existence at GROUND grain; בְּרֵאשִׁית (in the beginning) is a temporal adjunct (A2)

alternate.because: readable as two named creata rather than the world-field

rows.anchor: בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ

rows.subject: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ
rows.because: copula + a predicate of PRIVATION (תֹהוּ וָבֹהוּ, unformed-and-void) — the field's formlessness stated as its condition: the absence of order IS the asserted state, A4's family at ground grain

alternate.because: copula rule 4: formlessness read as a plain property held

rows.subject: וְחֹ֖שֶׁךְ
rows.because: a verbless nominal clause (the Arabic سواسية precedent): darkness [was] upon the face of the deep — presence held over a field, Relate·Existence at ground grain

rows.subject: וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים
rows.because: מְרַחֶפֶת (hovering) — one identified figure's presence held over the waters, the A5 landing family: Relate·Existence at figure grain
rows.anchor: וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִ֖ים
rows.because: the say-act: a sign emitted — Relate·Existence at figure grain; the jussive content (let there be light) stays inside the quoted object (A1) — what it commands is then separately asserted by the narrative's own וַיְהִי

alternate.because: the fiat readable as a bounded public act of definition, the proclaims family

rows.subject: אֽוֹר
rows.because: וַיְהִי (and there was) — light's coming-to-be: Generate·Existence; ground grain because this primal light is an ambient field (the next verse divides it from darkness as field from field), not a lamp

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִ֛ים
rows.because: seeing-that-it-was-good: perception carrying a VERDICT — a judgment held over one identified thing, Relate·Interpretation at figure grain (the perception family, with lear-france's never-see); the כִּי־טוֹב assessment stays inside the seen content (A1)
rows.anchor: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָא֖וֹר כִּי ט֑וֹב

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִ֔ים
rows.because: וַיַּבְדֵּל (divided-between) CUTS two primal fields apart — Differentiate·Structure at GROUND grain: the object is not a thing but the light-field and dark-field themselves, held apart
rows.anchor: וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֥ין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִ֤ים
rows.because: naming — a sign attached to and held over one identified thing: the heading-row family's own act (a name stands over what it names), Relate·Existence at figure grain

alternate.because: naming readable as bounding the named thing

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִ֤ים
rows.because: the second naming of the pair — same act, its own proposition
rows.resolution: the verb's subject carries from וַיִּקְרָא's אֱלֹהִים

rows.subject: עֶ֥רֶב
rows.because: the refrain: evening came-to-be and morning came-to-be — two ambient day-states arriving, Generate·Existence at ground grain; the paired וַיְהִי verbs are kept as one row (the Swahili serial precedent), and 'יוֹם אֶחָד' (day one) is a verbless count-apposition, folded (A2)
rows.anchor: וַֽיְהִי עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִ֔ים
rows.object: יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַמָּ֑יִם וִיהִ֣י מַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין מַ֖יִם לָמָֽיִם
rows.because: the say-act again; both jussives (let there be a firmament; let it be dividing) stay inside the quoted object (A1) — the making and the dividing are then asserted by the narrative in verse 7
rows.anchor: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַמָּ֑יִם

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִים֮
rows.because: וַיַּעַשׂ (made) — ONE identified thing brought into being: Generate·Existence at figure grain

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִים֮
rows.object: בֵּ֤ין הַמַּ֨יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִתַּ֣חַת לָרָקִ֔יעַ וּבֵ֣ין הַמַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעַ֣ל לָרָקִ֑יעַ
rows.because: the second primal division — the waters-below cut from the waters-above: Differentiate·Structure at ground grain; the locative אֲשֶׁר relatives are micro-relatives, folded (R1)
rows.resolution: the verb's subject carries from וַיַּעַשׂ's אֱלֹהִים
rows.anchor: וַיַּבְדֵּ֗ל בֵּ֤ין הַמַּ֨יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִתַּ֣חַת לָרָקִ֔יעַ

rows.subject: כֵֽן
rows.because: and-it-was-SO: the declared state of affairs realized — Generate·Existence at ground grain (the whole arrangement came to hold)

alternate.because: readable as word and world closing into one whole

rows.subject: אֱלֹהִ֛ים
rows.because: the third naming — the sign held over the made thing

rows.subject: עֶ֥רֶב
rows.because: the refrain's second occurrence — a second row on the same prop (R9's multi-row rule); 'יוֹם שֵׁנִי' folds as before
rows.anchor: וַֽיְהִי עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שֵׁנִֽי
